wiki-v3-1024.title: Cohere Wikipedia 2023-11, embed-multilingual-v3
wiki-v3-1024.description: Paragraph embeddings of Wikipedia from Cohere's embed-multilingual-v3 model, 1024 dimensions, unit-normalized (prepare measures norm 1.0), searched by inner product, which equals cosine here. All 323 languages interleaved in 10k-row chunks so every prefix is multilingual; queries come from seven of them.
